Pricing: PUT/GET rules trendyol margin_pct=40 rounding=0.99 persisted; POST /api/pricing/compute channel=trendyol → count=56, priced=45, push_supported=true, all priced rows have suggested ending .99, list_price ≈ suggested*1.10, margin_pct ≥ 40 (small overshoot expected due to round-up), net_profit ≥ cost*0.4, formula matches (raw ≤ suggested). Switching pricing-channel to shopphp removes push button and shows 'salt-okunur' note (count=1). /settings 'Sabah Özeti' tab (no data-testid on the tab itself; navigable via text 'Sabah Özeti'): morning-summary-settings visible, ms-preview populates ms-preview-text with header, ms-save toast 'Sabah özeti ayarları kaydedildi.', ms-send successful with ms-last='Son gönderim: 05.09.2026 18:04:56 · e-posta ✓'. Emails cleared and saved for cleanup. No push endpoints called; Trendyol prices untouched.

issues: Sub-navigation item 'Sabah Özeti' lacks a data-testid on its clickable button (only inner content has data-testid='morning-summary-settings' after selection). Adding a data-testid='settings-nav-summary' or similar to the nav link would improve testability.

critical_code_review_comments: pricing.py suggest_price(): with rounding='0.99' the round-UP causes actual margin_pct to overshoot the target (observed up to +0.6..+1 % on typical items and much more on cheap items). Consider surfacing this in the UI (e.g., color-code rows where realized margin deviates from target by >1%) or offer 'nearest' rounding as an option — the spec's ±0.5% tolerance is not achievable with strict round-UP-to-.99 semantics.

pricing.py get_rules(): filters keys against DEFAULT_RULE only, so any extra columns previously persisted (rounding='none' etc.) are correctly ignored — good. But DEFAULT_RULE lacks 'company_id' and the response omits 'channel' key inside each rule; if the frontend later needs to know which record it hydrated, this is fine (channel is the map key), but consider echoing it for symmetry with PUT response.

pricing.py send_summary(): swallows all comm_service exceptions into result.email.error — good. However when SMTP is actually configured the endpoint sends the email immediately without any confirmation gate; a manual 'send' button in production may spam real inboxes. Consider requiring an explicit ?confirm=true or a 'test' recipient override.
PricingCenter.jsx line 17: compute() catches error but does not clear stale `data` or show a placeholder, so the UI may keep displaying prior channel's rows if the new compute fails. Minor.
PricingCenter.jsx line 55: push button omits an aria-label; when disabled the tooltip 'Ürün seçin.' toast only fires on click (which is blocked when disabled). Fine but not ideal.
PricingCenter.jsx has no loading skeleton on first mount; between compute() call and response users see empty area for ~3s on Trendyol (56 rows).
/settings → 'Sabah Özeti' nav item lacks data-testid (see design_issues).
